description: Source code for a utility that interacts with the RDK host interface via IARM bus, providing get/set operations for device parameters, including IPC initialization, error handling, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: initilize
methods.description: Initializes IPC connectivity with the IARM bus, retrying until successful.

methods.name: getErrorDetails
methods.description: Returns a textual description of an error code from the host interface.

methods.name: getParamType
methods.description: Retrieves the parameter type for a given parameter name via IARM bus call.

methods.name: convertParamValues
methods.description: Converts string input values to appropriate parameter types based on parameter metadata.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts a character ('s', 'i', 'b') to the corresponding HostIf_ParamType_t enumeration.

methods.name: printParameterDetails
methods.description: Prints details of a parameter retrieved from the host interface.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value and details of a specified parameter.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: term
methods.description: Cleans up IPC setup by disconnecting and terminating the IARM bus.

methods.name: showusage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: parseargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine operation mode, parameter name, and value.

methods.name: trsetutil
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates parameter get/set operations based on command-line input.
